'''2006 World Championship Day 3 Brian Hunter DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 3), finishing 2nd; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter (2006-10-26).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35765 SYCFA done RIGHT aka Fear Attracts the Fearful]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071014025546/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35765 Internet Archive]</ref>
